```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)

```

# Premier nettoyage
## Aléatoires
```{r M1_A0 to M1_A1}
# Importer la base brute de l'identité
M1_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../../raw_data/gb_ddb_identite_01.sas7bdat")

vars_id_rmv <- c("id_type", "tab_db")
# 1. Correction classe  ---------------------------------------------------
corr_fact <- c("id_lieu_nais", "id_sexe")
corr_chr <- c("id_centre1", "id_centre2", "id_centre3", "id_dep_nais")

M1_A1 <- M1_A0 %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(corr_fact), as.factor)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(corr_chr), as.character)) %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_dep_nais = case_when(
      id_lieu_nais == 2 ~ "99",
      TRUE ~ id_dep_nais)
  ) %>% 
  select(-all_of(vars_id_rmv)) %>% 
  relocate(id_sep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  relocate(c("id_nom", "id_nom_jeune", "id_prenom", "id_sexe",
             "id_date_nais", "id_age", "id_lieu_nais", "id_dep_nais"
  ), .after = id_sep) 


```

```{r M1_A1 to M1_A2}

M1_A2 <- M1_A1 %>%
  
  # Compter le nombre de centres suivis
  # Ceux qui n'ont pas répondu ont -9
  mutate(
    id_nb_centres = case_when(
      is.na(id_centre1) ~ -9L,
      TRUE ~ rowSums(across(id_centre1:id_centre3, ~ !is.na(.)))
  )) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui n'ont pas répondu aux centres
  mutate(
    tout_na = if_all(id_centre1:id_centre2, is.na)
  ) %>% 
  
  # Recoder les NAs pour les centres
  mutate(
    across(
      id_centre1:id_centre3,
      ~ case_when(
        !is.na(.) ~ .,
        tout_na ~ "-9",
        is.na(.) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "ERR"
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  # Retirer notre variable intermédiaire
  select(-tout_na) %>% 
  
  # Recoder ceux qui n'ont pas répondu au dep de naissance
  mutate(
    id_dep_nais = replace_when(
      id_dep_nais,
      is.na(id_dep_nais) ~ "-9"
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  # Creer les identifiants pour lier les doublons
  mutate(
    id_doublon = case_when(
      !is.na(id_sep) ~ str_sub(id_sep, 7, 11),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    id_keep = id_anonymat,
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-id_sep) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )
  
rm(list = c("corr_chr", "corr_fact", "vars_id_rmv"))
```

## Ajouter les doublons
Ajouter les lignes pour les doublons aussi et faciliter les corrections des doublons dans les prochaines bases

```{r M1_A2 to M1_A3}

doublons <- M1_A2 %>% 
  
  # Ne garder que les doublons
  filter(!is.na(id_doublon)) %>% 
  
  # Modifier le id_anonymat
  select(-id_anonymat, id_anonymat = id_doublon) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_doublon = id_anonymat,
    .before = id_keep
  )

# Ajouter à la base générale

M1_A3 <- M1_A2 %>% 
  bind_rows(
    doublons
  ) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)


```

# Deuxième nettoyage


```{r}

M1_A2 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/to_tag/thoa_identite_tt.csv",
show_col_types = F)

```

## Retrait et ajout de colonnes


```{r}

M1_B0 <- M1_A2 %>% 
  select(-id_doublon, -id_keep) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_age_cat1 = if_else(id_age < 18, 1, 2),
    id_age_cat2 = case_when(
      id_age < 18 ~ 1,
      id_age < 25 ~ 2,
      id_age < 35 ~ 3,
      id_age < 45 ~ 4,
      id_age >= 45 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 999
    ),
    .after = id_age
  )

```

### Base dep centres

```{r}

id_centres <- readxl::read_xlsx("/Users/alicethomassin/Documents/Scolarité/[03] Master/[M1S2]/[M1S2] Stage/id_centres.xlsx")

id_centres_dist <- id_centres %>% 
  distinct(id_centre1, .keep_all = TRUE)

M5_D3 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/to_tag/thoa_logement_tt.csv",
show_col_types = F)

dep_centre1 <- M5_D3 %>% 
  select(id_anonymat, lo_dep_centre1)

id_dep_centre <- left_join(
  dep_centre1,
  M1_B0 %>% select(id_anonymat, id_centre1),
  by = "id_anonymat"
)


centres_presents <- id_dep_centre %>% 
  select(-id_anonymat) %>% 
  filter_out(if_any(where(is.numeric), ~ . < 0)) %>% 
  distinct()

complete_id_centres <- left_join(
  id_centres_dist,
  centres_presents,
  by = "id_centre1"
) %>% 
  rename("dep_centre" = "lo_dep_centre1",
  "id_centre" = "id_centre1") %>% 
  select(-TYPE)

```

```{r}

M1_B1 <- M1_B0 %>% 
  left_join(
    complete_id_centres %>% select(-CRCM),
    by = c("id_centre1" = "id_centre")
  ) %>% 
    rename("id_dep_centre1" = "dep_centre") %>% 
    relocate(id_dep_centre1, .after = id_centre1) %>% 
    left_join(
    complete_id_centres %>% select(-CRCM),
    by = c("id_centre2" = "id_centre")
  ) %>% 
    rename("id_dep_centre2" = "dep_centre") %>% 
    relocate(id_dep_centre2, .after = id_centre2) %>% 
    left_join(
    complete_id_centres %>% select(-CRCM),
    by = c("id_centre3" = "id_centre")
  ) %>% 
    rename("id_dep_centre3" = "dep_centre") %>% 
    relocate(id_dep_centre3, .after = id_centre3)

all_dep_centres <- M1_B1 %>% 
  select(matches("dep_centre\\d")) %>% 
  colnames()

M1_B2 <- M1_B1 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(all_of(all_dep_centres), ~ replace_when(
      .x,
      is.na(.x) ~ get(str_remove(cur_column(), "dep_"))
    ))
  )

```

## Recoder NAs doubles Stata

```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_tagged_na.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_levels_na.R")

vars_dbl <- M1_B2 %>% 
  select(where(is.double)) %>% 
  select(-id_date_creation, -id_date_nais) %>% 
  colnames()

# Les deux fonctions fonctionnent!

M1_C0 <- M1_B2 %>%
  rcd_tagged_na(all_of(vars_dbl)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_dbl), rcd_levels_na))

table(as_factor(M1_C0$id_nb_centres), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("vars_dbl", "rcd_levels_na", "rcd_tagged_na"))

```

## Labeliser les modalités


```{r}

list_deps_en <- readr::read_csv("Muco_2026/list_dep_en.csv", show_col_types = F)

etiq_dep <- set_names(list_deps_en$dep_num, list_deps_en$dep_txt)

M1_C1 <- M1_C0 %>% 
  add_value_labels(
    id_dep_nais = etiq_dep,
    id_dep_centre1 = etiq_dep,
    id_dep_centre2 = etiq_dep,
    id_dep_centre3 = etiq_dep,
    id_sexe = c(
      "Male" = 1,
      "Female" = 2
    ),
    id_lieu_nais = c(
      "France (mainland or overseas)" = 1,
      "Abroad" = 2
    ),
    id_age_cat1 = c(
      "Minor (under 18)" = 1,
      "Adult (18 and over)" = 2
    ),
    id_age_cat2 = c(
      "Under 18" = 1,
      "18-24" = 2,
      "25-34" = 3,
      "35-44" = 4,
      "45 and over" = 5
    )
  )


table(as_factor(M1_C1$id_dep_nais), useNA = "ifany")

    
rm(list = c("etiq_dep", "list_deps_en"))


```

# METADATA

```{r}
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
M1_C2 <- haven::read_dta("data_hors_git/Peter/thoa1_Identity_454.dta")

dico_ID <- generate_dictionary(M1_C2) %>% 
  convert_list_columns_to_character() %>% 
  select(variable, label, col_type, value_labels) %>% 
  mutate(
    origin = if_else(str_detect(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+ "), "question", "derived"),
    ref = str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+")
  ) %>% 
    relocate(ref, .after = variable)
```


```{r}
identity <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/files/identity.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

meta_id <- identity %>% 
  mutate(
    ref = str_replace_all(variable, "-", "0"),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "_\\w+$", ""),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "0(?=\\d{2,})", ""),
    .before = variable
  ) %>% 
    select(-variable) %>% 
  left_join(
    dico_ID %>% select(variable, ref),
    by = "ref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>% 
    relocate(variable) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(variable)) %>% 
    mutate(
      notes_fr = NA_character_,
      notes_en = NA_character_
    )

# readr::write_csv(meta_id, "data_hors_git/files/meta_id.csv")

```
